summary: Iteration 31: tested new CRM Comercial (Fase 2). Backend: 15/15 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_crm.py — covers ICP GET/POST + AI suggest (structure), lead CRUD, deterministic lead score changes (low: 54 morno -> high: >=70 quente after urgency alta + valor alto + fit ICP + stage negociacao), move stage (200 + invalid stage 400), email/proposal drafts (return kind + draft dict), pipeline_value excludes 'perdido', DELETE removes lead, and regression on /goal and /council/meeting. Frontend: full UI flow verified live on admin — nav-crm, crm-page, icp-card, icp-suggest-btn, icp-save-btn present, all 7 columns column-<stage> render, add-lead-btn opens lead-dialog, lead-input-name/value + lead-save-btn create lead with score badge (lead-score-<id>), lead-stage-<id> Select moves card between columns, lead-delete-<id> removes it, draft-email-<id> opens draft-dialog with body and draft-copy-btn. Regression: /painel, /meta, /conselho-executivo all 200.
critical_code_review_comments: crm.py compute_lead_score baseline is 40; even an empty lead with default stage 'novo' scores at least 44 (baseline + baixa default 4). This is fine but a totally empty lead visually appears 'morno' with no data — consider making the baseline lower or gating urgency default to 0.

crm.py upsert_lead does not validate lead ownership via company_id on update path (only user_id). If a user moves companies but the lead belongs to another company_id, it could still be edited via the user_id filter. Consider adding company_id to the filter for stricter isolation.

crm.py upsert_lead: when lead_id references a non-existent doc, code silently upserts nothing then returns the (None) doc which will 500. Recommend returning 404 explicitly if existing is None on update path.

crm.py list_leads pipeline_value: could also exclude 'ganho' if the intent is 'open' pipeline (currently 'ganho' is included). Confirm product intent; today only 'perdido' is excluded per spec — matches spec.

CRM.jsx saveLead: closes dialog before awaiting the toast — fine, but the newly-created lead object is not read from the response; instead loadLeads() re-fetches. Acceptable but adds an extra roundtrip.
CRM.jsx genDraft: on error, closes dialog (setDraft(null)) which is good UX; however draftLoading is still set true briefly — no visible glitch observed. Cosmetic.
CRM.jsx uses navigator.clipboard.writeText which requires a secure context; on preview URL it works, but consider a fallback for embedded iframes.
crm.py draft_lead ai_json can return {} if AI response is empty; UI will render empty draft-body silently. Consider returning 502 or a default body when AI fails.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_ leads (TEST_low, TEST_UI_Lead) which were deleted at end of tests. ICP for admin was updated with sector=Restauração, size=pequena, region=Lisboa (real change persisted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with: python -m pytest backend/tests/test_crm.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. All CRM endpoints under /api/crm/*. Stages array: [novo, qualificado, reuniao, proposta, negociacao, ganho, perdido]. Lead score is deterministic (compute_lead_score in routers/crm.py) — validated via score change on update. Drafts use ai_json — allow up to 90s. Admin ICP was set during tests; if this affects other tests, reset via POST /api/crm/icp with empty values.
